verdict.rationale: Mailchimp clearly markets its own automation feature: the homepage promises "automations", pricing lists "Enhanced automations", Analytics AI references automations, and a community user mentions building a Mailchimp automation. Transactional also offers event-driven messaging and inbound routing rules. However, nothing in the pack documents how users define triggers, conditions or actions, so the depth of the rule engine is unproven; webhooks only let an external app react, which is a developer building block rather than in-product rules. Missing for 10: documentation of trigger/condition/action rule definitions, the supported event types for automations, AI-native or programmatic rule creation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
